params.from_rows: data/funding_creators.jsonl (run 1, re-traced with the expanded label set)

definitions.fresh_creator: creator history complete, <=5 txs before the create tx and first tx <=24h before create
definitions.direct_funder_kind: cex (labeled), fresh_intermediary (<=10 txs, born <=48h before funding), wallet (other unlabeled <=2000 txs), exchange_like (>2000 txs, unlabeled), via_bridge/via_dex (funds arrived through a labeled program from a PDA/relayer)
definitions.bundled: >=2 distinct non-creator buyers in the creation slot (swap-api trades)

siblings.why: labeled CEX Binance 1, 1 sampled creators at this amount
labeled CEX Binance 1, 2 sampled creators at this amount

arms.recent: 100 most recent unique creators (coins >=3 min old)
arms.notable: 40 creators of coins in the pool with ATH >= $8k (USD, from API)
arms.bundled: 40 creators whose creation slot had >=2 non-creator buyers putting >=1 SOL in (58/400 screened coins = 14.5% qualified)

sample_design.run2: same 180 creators re-traced after adding ravexutils + discovered labels (Bybit iGdF, FixedFloat, MoonPay, Relay solver)
sample_design.bias_note: only the 'recent' arm is a (near) random sample of launches; 'notable' and 'bundled' are deliberately enriched
